bread.name: Rock-bread
bread.desc: Hard as a rock, cheap, filling. (ch. 16, 22: ~20 stones)

potion.name: Healing Potion
potion.desc: Restores 40 HP. Like the Parthran potion Drusz gave Bjorn (ch. 5).

torch.name: Magic Torch
torch.desc: Burns for 3 days. Lets you see in dark zones, but monsters see you too. (ch. 23: ~10,000 stones)

vial.name: Essence Vial
vial.desc: Stores an essence instead of absorbing it, so it can be sold. (ch. 31: 'outrageously expensive')

hammer.name: War Hammer
hammer.desc: Like the hammer Bjorn took from Hans (ch. 7).

round_shield.name: Round Shield
round_shield.desc: The shield Bjorn chose at the coming-of-age ceremony (ch. 3).

tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
tower_shield.desc: A barbarian's best friend. Heavy: Agility -1.

half_plate.name: Half Plate
half_plate.desc: Bought by Bjorn after his first big haul (ch. 21). Heavy: Agility -1.

helmet.name: Iron Helmet
helmet.desc: Protects the one thing a barbarian rarely uses.
